caption: The drawing shows a stylized bird, predominantly colored in shades of dark and light blue, perched among an arrangement of circular and oval leaves and vine-like structures that are also rendered in blue. The bird's tail feathers are long and flowing, extending to the left side of the composition, with a textured linear pattern, while the body is elongated and marked with round, raised spots. The plant elements feature thick, curling stems with multiple round leaves that vary in size. The background of the image is a light tan or beige color with scattered brown speckles. At the top of the drawing, there is stamped text in gray that reads "N.A. WHITE & SON UTICA, N.Y. 4" and, at the bottom right, the name "John Sgraham" is written in small letters.
title: Crock
